description: This file defines the interface for VAP (Virtual Access Point) service management, including types, function pointers, and external functions for starting, stopping, updating, and handling events for different VAP service types such as private, public, mesh gateway, and mesh extender.

methods.name: svc_init
methods.description: Initializes a vap_svc_t structure with specified service type.

methods.name: get_svc_by_type
methods.description: Retrieves a VAP service instance by control structure and service type.

methods.name: get_svc_by_vap_index
methods.description: Retrieves a VAP service instance by control structure and VAP index.

methods.name: get_svc_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a VAP service instance by control structure and VAP name.

methods.name: process_ext_connect_algorithm
methods.description: Processes external connection algorithm for a given VAP service.
